arguments.content: Document ID: CONSENT-DECREE-2026-044; Matter: MAT-2026-0587; Parties: Pinnacle Healthcare Systems v. MedTech Solutions Inc.; Settlement Amount: $2,300,000; Filing Party: MedTech Solutions Inc.; Attorney: ATT-PARTNER-003 (IL-556210)

RE: Pinnacle Healthcare Systems v. MedTech Solutions Inc. (CASE-2026-044) – Settlement Offer of $2.3M

The opposing party has submitted a final settlement offer of $2.3 million, within the $2–3 million range authorized by your board resolution BR-2026-009. We have reviewed the settlement agreement (SETTLE-AGR-2026-044) and confirm that the financial terms are favorable and within mandate. However, the agreement contains two high-risk provisions: (1) a one-sided indemnification clause (Section 8.1) requiring MedTech to indemnify Pinnacle even for claims arising from Pinnacle’s own negligence; and (2) an overbroad 24-month non-compete (Section 12.1) covering all jurisdictions where Pinnacle operates, which is likely unenforceable but may trigger litigation risk.

We recommend accepting the $2.3M offer on condition that the following redline changes be accepted by opposing counsel: (1) convert indemnification to mutual with carve-outs for gross negligence; (2) narrow the non-compete to 12 months and specific geographic markets. If these revisions are not accepted, we advise proceeding with acceptance of the current terms, given the time sensitivity and favorable financial outcome. Please confirm your instructions by 9:00 AM ET tomorrow to allow time for execution and filing prior to the 11:00 AM ET deadline.
